ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Generic - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo

sequences.query: ((ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-EncodedCommand\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-ec\\ .*")) AND (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-window\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-windowstyle\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ 1\\ .*")) AND (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-noni\\ .*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-noninteractive\\ .*")))
